posts.headline: I built a tiny free tool that makes brand assets.
posts.body:
I wanted a simple way to make brand assets without teaching an AI the visual language from scratch every time.

So I built Make Brand Assets For Me. It is a free, MIT-licensed plugin with six plain-language skills. Show it approved examples. Give one asset a clear job. It plans, makes, checks and saves the result.

The slightly ridiculous proof: the new Make My Launch Pack skill generated the coordinated graphics for this launch.

The cut-paper, soft-clay and bold-print gallery brands are fictional examples. Bring your own real brand examples when you use it.

Get the plugin free on GitHub.

If the real bottleneck in your business lives in the inbox, I also offer a free 60-minute inbox audit.

posts.headline: I made a free brand asset plugin.
posts.body:
Make Brand Assets For Me turns your approved examples into a small brand recipe, then helps an AI make and check new assets against it. Version 0.2.2 adds a complete image-first launch-pack skill with deterministic portable typography.

These campaign graphics are the worked example. Each one starts with a generated editorial background, protects real negative space, and adds fewer than 15 words afterwards. The method is yours to use with your own brand.

Download it free on GitHub. If your real operations problem is an overloaded inbox, book a free 60-minute Lemonbrand inbox audit.
